title: Typed budget authority in NodeDefinition: AdmissionAmount[] + AdmissionGate replace the unitless scalar
description:
Filed by governor-e01ddc57 2026-08-20 18:26Z executing a HUMAN-DELEGATED decision (REPL: "decide best option as we really want amazing product and to use it already"). Governor ruling: typed budget authority lands IN the NodeAuthority chain — one durable authority, no parallel scalar→typed mapping layer, no unit-by-fiat. Evidence base: architect-b7e7325e's block on task-e194c5f6 (msg-62b46994, measured at HEAD 60a043a-era).

THE GAP: NodeDefinition (66250d83, DONE) carries only unitless `budgetRequest: number`. Budget reservation (e194c5f6) needs closed typed AdmissionAmount[] {meter, amount} + AdmissionGate derived from durable facts; no production derivation exists; treating the scalar as ms, copying it across meters, or accepting caller payload would invent authority.

SCOPE: successor to 66250d83 extending the NodeDefinition/NodeAuthority contract: (1) a CLOSED meter enum — enumerate meters from what the system already durably measures (planner probes: provider-run telemetry carries token/wall-clock facts; scheduler budget reducers name their meters — the enum must be grounded in existing durable measurement, never speculative meters); (2) AdmissionAmount[] and gate policy as canonical contract fields with codec + digest coverage (new versioned domain per the 154ce48d discipline); (3) the bare scalar RETIRES from the contract (or is explicitly demoted with a comment) — never both authorities live.

SEQUENCING: this must land BEFORE the 329f02f5 chain's downstream links consume the definition shape (39c4bccd recursion is BLOCKED-not-started — the surface can still gain fields cheaply; 8c7e6ce4 fixture hardening must bind the TYPED shape, not the scalar). Coordinate with the chain's standing pitfalls on the 329f02f5 parent.

CONSUMERS: task-e194c5f6 (reservation — its block names this exact gap; re-verify its premise at landing) and transitively task-a91e9fe2 (settlement).
definitionOfDone: NodeDefinition contract carries AdmissionAmount[] {meter, amount} with a CLOSED meter enum grounded in durably-measured meters, plus the admission gate policy; codec + digest coverage under a new versioned domain; deep-frozen results
The unitless budgetRequest scalar is retired from the contract (or explicitly demoted non-authority with a comment); no dual authority
Exclusion/sensitivity drills per the 154ce48d pattern: each new field moves the digest; a leaked excluded field reds byte-identity; collapsing the meter enum reds
task-e194c5f6's blocking premise re-verified satisfiable at the landing HEAD, and the 329f02f5 chain's downstream links are named with whether each needs amendment

(3) GATE-SHAPE DECISION to pin before tests: read AdmissionPolicyAllowance/AdmissionHumanApproval — if either carries WITNESS/GRANT-shaped authority (an approval instance), the NodeDefinition must carry the gate POLICY (which gate applies), never a pre-granted approval — a definition that embeds its own approval is minted authority; decide + record (likely: a closed gatePolicy discriminant or the AdmissionGate shape with approval constrained null-at-definition-time). (4) THE CLOSED METER ENUM, grounded in durable measurement only — enumerate from: budget-contract.ts's named conventions (:19 comment — runner.authorized_ms, verification.authorized_ms + siblings), the project-configuration LIMIT KEYS (capturedOutputBytes/uiTailBytes/runnerAuthorizedMsPerAttempt/activeProviderSessions — already durably configured), and provider-run telemetry's NormalizedMeasurement meter names (the durable usage record). The budget module's meter stays an OPEN string by design ("admits provider-specific meters") — the CONTRACT's enum is the authority-side bound; document that relationship in the contract header. Any meter not durably measured today is EXCLUDED (never speculative). (5) Baseline: `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test` + typecheck, separate exits, counts verbatim.
